notes: Tscraper update + selector hot-patch manifest. The extension fetches this on load. To announce a new build, bump 'latest' and set 'url'. To fix a Telegram DOM change WITHOUT a reinstall, put a { "SEL": {..}, "MEDIA": [[type,sel],..] } object in 'selectors' — every installed copy applies it automatically. Keep 'latest' = the current shipped version so existing users don't see a false update banner.
